name: Toaru Hitozuma no Netorare Jijou
original_name: とある人妻のネトラレ事情
source:
This visual novel is about the 40-day adulterous corruption of a married woman by the company supervisor.

In the beginning, the wife's cell phone is bugged with spyware to read all her email.
Undisclosed details and photos she hides from her husband can also be accessed.

[edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE117794.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
这部视觉小说讲述了一名已婚妇女被公司主管通奸腐败40天的故事。

一开始，妻子的手机被间谍软件窃听，以读取她的所有电子邮件。
她向丈夫隐瞒的未公开细节和照片也可以访问。

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE117794.html]DLsite English[/url]]
